newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

** The Indonesian economy is likely to grow by 7.5 percent in 1997 against an expected 7.3 percent in 1996 despite political uncertainties and a slow-down in export growth, an Indonesian economic think-tank said.
** The Dow industrials average rose 14.54 points to 6,007.02 on Friday, bolstered by an unexpectedly strong earnings report from Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co., one of the stocks in the index.
** The Jakarta composite index closed down 4.55 points, or 0.79 percent, at 571.34 points on Friday due to widespread profit-taking including in newly listed fisheries firm PT Daya Guna Samudra.
** On Monday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,326.50/27.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,326.50/27.25.
** Energy firm Medco Energy on newspaper reports of a possible link-up with a foreign firm, possibly a Malaysian mining firm.
** Property firm Ometraco Realty on a plan to acquire private-owned property firms PT Angkasa Interland and PT Lestari Basuki.
** Property firm Suryamas Duta Makmur on market talk of a possible rights issue.
** Automobile conglomerate Astra and cigarette firm Sampoerna following active trading last week due to reports of a huge stake purchase by the Nusamba group and the Salim group.
** Fisheries firm Daya Guna Samudra following an encouraging debut last week.
